nodes.name: Make PDF link-readable
nodes.notes: ⚠️ Anyone with the link can read this voucher. It carries the guest's name, phone and what they paid. Interakt must fetch it unauthenticated, so there is no way around it — but keep the Voucher folder itself private, and prune old files.

nodes.name: WhatsApp via Interakt
nodes.notes: ⚠️ `name`, `languageCode` and the ORDER of bodyValues must match the template approved in Interakt exactly. Meta rejects a mismatched variable count with a generic error, so check the template first. Header must be type DOCUMENT.
